JCSD Waterline PACE Tool: preview

Jurupa Community Services District

WSC built a fully working PACE tool mock-up on the District's water mains for this proposal. This page is a lightweight version of it, limited to pictures of the working tool to protect the District's data. Unit costs, consequence weights, and expected service lives are illustrative until the District's records and workshop decisions replace them.

Risk: click a main and see why it scores as it does

Staff adjust the consequence weights and the likelihood blend. A selected main shows its likelihood, consequence, risk cell, Remaining Useful Life (RUL), the factors behind the scores, and its lifecycle curve. Overlays mark high-risk mains and mains near end of life.

Dashboard: system risk over time and renewal need by year

The dashboard tracks total system risk with and without the capital improvement program (CIP), feet of main reaching end of life each year, CIP cost against the funding level, and the risk matrix.

Funding at the plan level

Lower funding

Higher funding

Project builder: from high-risk mains to buildable projects

WSC's recommended projects load by year. Staff add or remove mains, set the method and size for each main, drop pavement restoration when a project is coordinated with paving, start a new project with a name and budget, and return any WSC project to its recommendation.

WSC project selected

Staff project added

CIP: projects by year with exports

Staff move projects between years and see cost, feet, and risk reduced against each year's funding. The CIP exports to an Excel workbook and to a cut sheet per project.

Ten-year CIP

Lower funding

Re-placed by risk per dollar

Model check: new break data, outside scores, and the delivered layer

New break records load and update prediction success by cohort. Likelihood scores from another source load beside the tool's scores. The delivered mains layer exports for edits in GIS and reimports for a fresh run.

Before an import

After a break import

Settings: costs, lives, and limits in one place

Unit costs by diameter and method, pavement restoration by road class, cost shares, RUL bands, expected service lives by material, and project limits. Every setting is also adjustable per project.
